These files are verbatim copies of card scripts from the Forge project
(https://github.com/Card-Forge/forge, forge-gui/res/cardsfolder/), which is licensed GPL-3.0.
They are here only as test data for forge_scripts.py / forge_rules.py, so the tests run without
a network. Do not redistribute them without complying with the GPL-3.0 licence.
The game itself downloads scripts into cache/forge/ on the player's own computer.
